title: Weekly customer health report
prompt: For every active enterprise customer, collect commercial context, deployment health, open support signals, and unresolved work. Classify each as healthy, watch, or at risk and produce an evidence-backed summary table.
expected_behavior: Keep missing signals explicit rather than inventing them.
Use customer IDs to join records.
Attach evidence to every non-healthy classification.
Do not let Northwind records leak into Alpine or Lumon rows.
